# Generated by the ZIN content builder (tools/content/modules/technologies.mjs). Do not edit by hand.
# Sets the first air doctrine for a country that receives its first dragon (docs/specs/03_gameplay/09_naval_air_doctrines.md section 8).
# Called by zin_war_grant_dragons when the receiver has no air grand doctrine. It costs no experience and adds 50 Sky Valour.
zin_inst_air_start = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_any_grand_doctrine = air }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				zin_rules_skies_beasts = yes
				zin_tech_people_men = yes
				NOT = { check_variable = { zin_dragon_flights > 0 } }
			}
			set_grand_doctrine = zin_gd_griffin_eyries
			set_sub_doctrine = zin_sub_lance_wings
		}
		else = {
			set_grand_doctrine = zin_gd_wings_of_the_mountain
			set_sub_doctrine = zin_sub_fire_from_above
		}
		air_experience = 50
	}
}
